The structure of Mn4Zn4Bi4 (reduced formula MnZnBi) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies 8-fold coordination for Bi, Mn, and Zn centers, each surrounded by four Bi, four Mn, and four Zn neighbors, respectively, with neighbor distances of 2.8534 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component containing all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner, edge, and face sharing among Bi, Mn, and Zn 8-vertex coordination polyhedra, though these patterns are not exclusive to all polyhedra.
